title: Prismatic Alert Monitor
description: An alert monitor defines conditions for monitoring instance executions and triggering notifications when those conditions are met.

id.description: Unique identifier for the alert monitor

triggered.description: Whether the alert is currently in a triggered state

triggerType.description: Type of trigger condition for the alert

instance.description: The instance this alert monitor is attached to

groups.description: Alert groups that receive notifications from this monitor

durationSecondsCondition.description: Duration threshold in seconds for duration-based triggers

logSeverityLevelCondition.description: Log severity level threshold for severity-based triggers

executionOverdueMinutes.description: Minutes past expected schedule before triggering overdue alert

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the alert monitor was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the alert monitor was last updated
